meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: MUST USE after building/changing any UI or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Rigorous visual QA across web/page and terminal UIs. Prefer browser:control-in-app-browser for unauthenticated browser/page QA in Codex, then Playwright/agent-browser/dev-browser. Captures screenshot/TUI evidence with bundled diff scripts, runs design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK reviewer passes, then synthesizes a good/bad verdict. Triggers: visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, UI looks wrong, reference fidelity, design system check, responsive check, CJK text clipping, TUI alignment, box-drawing drift.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动检查UI页面和终端界面的视觉正确性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要自动化验证UI的像素级正确性
copy.tagline_en: Automatically verify visual correctness of UI pages and terminal interfaces
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automated pixel-level UI verification

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在构建或修改任何界面后会做视觉检查：截图或捕获终端画面，用脚本算差异，派两个只读审查者分别检查设计系统/功能与视觉保真/CJK，最后给出通过或修改的裁决。
howto.when: 当用户要求视觉 QA、截图/像素对比，或询问页面/组件/终端界面看起来是否正确时触发。

say.text: 帮我对比这个页面和参考图，做视觉 QA
say.note: 运行图像差异并生成证据。

say.text: 检查这个 TUI 的边框对齐和中文文本是否裁剪
say.note: 运行终端宽度检查并审查。

say.text: 这个界面看起来不对劲，用 visual-qa 全面检查一遍

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude runs visual QA on built/changed UIs: captures screenshots or terminal frames, computes diffs via scripts, dispatches two read-only reviewers (design-system/functional and visual-fidelity/CJK), then issues a pass/revise verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for visual QA, screenshot/pixel diff, or whether a page/component/TUI looks right.

say_en.text: Compare this page against the reference and run visual QA.
Check this TUI's border alignment and CJK text clipping.
This UI looks off—run the full visual-qa pass.
say_en.note: Triggers both capture tracks and dual review.
